tools.name: ask_site
tools.description: Search this site's own published content — service pages, the 2026 financial-aid guide, the FAQ, and the 'Conseils & Actualités' articles — and return the matching passages with their URLs. Use this for any visitor question about Lionel BROT SASU: what work they do, MaPrimeRénov'/CEE/éco-PTZ rules and eligibility, indicative prices and lead times, RGE certification, the Paris / Île-de-France coverage area, opening hours or contact details. Content is in French. Returns up to 5 matches, each with title, URL and a text extract — compose the answer from those extracts, not from memory.

query.description: The visitor question or keywords, in French where possible.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the renovation services this company offers — isolation thermique (ITE, ITI, combles), pompe à chaleur, VMC simple et double flux, menuiseries double vitrage, and rénovation énergétique de copropriété — each with a short summary and the URL of its detail page. Use this when a visitor asks what the company does, or before recommending a service or preparing a quote request. Reads the live list from the site, so it stays correct if the services change.

tools.name: prepare_quote_request
tools.description: Prepare a free quote request ('demande de devis') for this renovation company. Collects the visitor's contact details and a description of the work, validates them, navigates to the Contact/Devis page and displays a visible recap card showing exactly what will be sent. This does NOT send anything — it returns a short-lived confirmation token, and `submit_quote_request` becomes available to actually send it once the visitor has seen the recap. Use this as soon as a visitor asks for a quote, an estimate, a site visit or a call back.

adresse_travaux.description: Street address of the site where the work will be carried out.

code_postal.description: Five-digit French postal code of the work site.

ville.description: Town or city of the work site.

descriptif.description: What the visitor wants done: type of service, surface area, current condition, timing.
